data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Attractions & Tickets, enter city, enter keyword, search, sort, open a result), but it makes the keyword optional and treats the final action vaguely ("Nearby" or an info icon, "if needed"). It also doesn't name the action (view nearby or add to favorites) as a parameter, though it is mostly concrete enough to automate.
